# Awakening Cave Pixel Assets (`dist/assets/awakening/`)

Subterranean Moon Orchid Cavern sprites & seamless `32×32` environment tiles aligned at `1:1` crisp pixel scale (`tile = 32`) with `huyen-bao-travel.png`, `ao-reu-travel.png`, `central-gu-master.png`, and `world/bamboo.png`.

- **`nguyet-lan-tiles.png`** (`128×32`, 4 variants `32×32`, binary alpha, bottom-center anchored `(16, 31)`).
- **`hy-vong-gu.png`** (`64×16`, 4 flight frames `16×16`, binary alpha): pea-sized lantern-firefly sprite.
- **`cave-tiles.png`** (`256×128`, `8×4` grid of `32×32` tiles, binary alpha): seamless stratified limestone walls, ceiling stalactite overhangs, lower cavern cliff rims, slate flagstones, river stepping stones, moss garden floor, shore overhangs, stone cave lanterns (*Thạch Đăng*), and Hope Gu plinth halos.
- **`cave-spring.png`** (`64×160`): underground **Linh Tuyền** spirit spring basin at the east end of the cavern.
- **`awakening-preview.png`**: visual sheet preview.
- **`awakening-assets.json`**: tile layout, anchor, and variant metadata.
